units.source_text: 于是她就地挪了挪跪坐着的右腿，又拿起三弦琴放在腿肚子上，

en.t: So she shifted her kneeling right leg where she sat, then picked up the shamisen again and set it on her calf.

units.source_text: 把腰扭向左边，向右倾斜着身子，

en.t: She twisted her waist to the left and leaned her body to the right,
she gazed at the neck of the shamisen and said:
